doc.title: Michael Abene interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003

title: Closing thanks
summary: Rowe thanks Abene and they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well it’s been serious fun talking with you today, I want to tell you. It’s been really a great conversation and I appreciate it. And I hope you don’t get too panicked with your upcoming project. So thanks for your time today.
Thank you, Monk. Thank you very much, really. Thank you. Thanks. ©Fillius Jazz Archive -26-
